title: Proper-image hypotheses for the recorded admissible coefficient objects
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], let $p:X\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $\Lambda$ be an admissible condensed coefficient in the recorded isomorphism-invariant sense of [sk-def-localizing-closure], including the ring of all continuous maps into $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Then the total right derived module-object pushforward $Rp_*$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] preserves bounded constant-model constructible objects of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and preserves every existing ambient discrete colimit indexed in $\mathrm{Type}(u+2)$ whose vertices lie in $\operatorname{Loc}(\mathrm{Dctf}(X,\Lambda))$ [sk-def-localizing-closure]. These are the two clauses of the existing predicate ProperLocalizingHypotheses. This does not identify the continuous-map algebraic-closure ring with the finite-subextension-valued ring in the older proper-image interface.

source.place: Second paragraph, Proper direct image, with the recorded admissible coefficient convention.

proof.text: Apply the existing representative coefficient theorem for finite rings, Z_ell, Q_ell, finite extensions E, their valuation rings, and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure. The finite nilpotence hypothesis follows by applying the admissibility annihilation condition to 1. Use det-sf-comp-proper-continuous-algcl for the remaining continuous-map algebraic-closure representative.

Use lem-sfb-condensed-coefficient-iso-constructible for Dctf preservation under coefficient isomorphisms, and det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude for isomorphism invariance. Minimality of the localizing closure and coproduct preservation by the exact scalar-restriction equivalence give preservation of the closures. The derived restriction-pushforward comparison conjugates proper pushforward by these equivalences. Transfer Dctf preservation and the ambient coproduct comparisons through this conjugation; the closure and conjugation arguments are proved by private Lean helpers.

proof_origin.place: Second paragraph; six literal representatives and all coefficient-isomorphism transport proved in Lean; the separate all-continuous representative is supplied by its proved wrapper.

lean.statement:
theorem properLocalizingHypotheses_admissible
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] :
    ProperLocalizingHypotheses Λ p
